            _tag = ("⛔ DISQUALIFIED — the field alone calls gold" if _r["leaks"] else
                    "⚠️ UNDECIDABLE (coverage below floor)" if _r["undecidable"] else "✅ no leak")
            print("  FIELD-ALONE LEAK GATE [%-5s] acc %.4f vs derived chance %.4f · coverage %.4f  %s"
                  % (_m, _r["acc"], _r["chance"], _r["coverage"], _tag))
        print("  HEURISTIC AUDIT (all must be exactly 0.500000): " + " · ".join(
            "%s=%s" % (k, ap["per_slot"][0][k]) for k in sorted(ap["per_slot"][0])))
        print("  slot independence: worst pairwise |P(gold_a=gold_b)-0.5| = %s (pair %s)"
              % (ap["worst_pairwise_dev"], ap["worst_pair"]))
        print("  0-SHOT ✅ every held-out word form occurs 0x in the drill corpus "
              "(word-boundary split, never substring — corpus-py-1 (G))")
        print("  codebook = the FULL 2^%d factorial ⇒ GF(2) rank %d, no prefix-determined column. "
              "VERIFY IT, do not assume it:" % (K, K))
        print("    anima-py evaluate --free-slot-score %s --pregate-bar 0.15" % cj)
        print("  score:  anima-py evaluate <clm> --bind-panel %s" % pj)
        print("  F2 liveness (DRILLED lexemes — read it FIRST; a floor-level held-out number on a "
              "model that cannot do the drilled cells is unattributable):")
        print("          anima-py evaluate <clm> --bind-panel %s" % sj)
        return 0

    if fmt == "counterfactual-decl":
        if not opts["out"]:
            print("anima corpus counterfactual-decl: --out c.txt is required", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(2)
        held_stems, held_ops = opts["held_out"]
        text, st = build_counterfactual_decl(
            opts["n_blocks"], opts["stems_per_episode"], opts["seed"], opts["lang"],
            held_stems, held_ops, n_eval_episodes=opts["eval_episodes"])
        # regeneration fingerprint (corpus-py-1 ⑫/(J)): the EXACT argv that produced these bytes is
        # written into every artifact, so a later session can rebuild the identical pool instead of
        # silently running a different experiment.
        regen = "anima-py corpus " + " ".join(argv)
        st["manifest"]["regen_cmd"] = regen
        with open(opts["out"], "w", encoding="ascii") as fh:
            fh.write(text)
        # AUDIT AFTER THE WRITE, FROM THE FILE ON DISK — the balance claim is only evidence if it
        # was measured on the bytes that were actually emitted.
        audit = audit_counterfactual_decl(opts["out"], st)
        audit["regen_cmd"] = regen
        ej = opts["out"] + ".decl.json"
        json.dump(st["manifest"], open(ej, "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False)
        aj = opts["out"] + ".audit.json"
        json.dump(audit, open(aj, "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
        # .storelines.txt (+ lockstep .store.jsonl) = the QUERY-LINES-ONLY surface for the
        # co-trained store lane (`--store-fuse pairodd`), which requires a strict 1:1
        # line<->row lockstep and therefore cannot carry the episodic declaration lines. Same
        # episodes, same RNG stream: the declaration BYTES charge the store's key/value
        # (entities = declared stems, pols = declared senses), while the operator declaration
        # rides the prompt — storebind's "store holds the FACT, text the OPERATOR" contract.
        sl = opts["out"] + ".storelines.txt"
        with open(sl, "w", encoding="ascii") as fh:
            for r in st["store_rows"]:
                fh.write(r["prompt"] + r["gold"] + "\n")
        with open(sl + ".store.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            for r in st["store_rows"]:
                fh.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        mj = opts["out"] + ".meta.json"
        json.dump({"fmt": "counterfactual-decl", "lang": st["lang"], "bytes": st["bytes"],
                   "lines": st["lines"], "n_blocks": st["n_blocks"],
                   "stems_per_episode": st["stems_per_ep"], "seed": st["seed"],
                   "regen_cmd": regen,
                   "min_steps": None, "min_lr": None,
                   "note": ("no MEASURED budget floor for this format yet — the WRITE gate on the "
                            "resulting ckpt decides; do NOT transplant another format's floor"),
                   "forget_strata": ["heldout-map-stem", "heldout-map-op"]},
                  open(mj, "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
        a = audit["answer"]
        print("anima corpus counterfactual-decl [%s]: episodes=%d stems/ep=%d lines=%d bytes=%d "
              "seed=%d -> %s" % (st["lang"], st["n_blocks"], st["stems_per_ep"], st["lines"],
                                 st["bytes"], st["seed"], opts["out"]))
        print("  pools: stems rot=%d frozen=%d held=%d · ops rot=%d frozen=%d held=%d "
              "(--held-out %d,%d = held-out STEM,OPERATOR names for this format)"
              % (st["n_rot_stems"], st["n_frozen_stems"], st["n_heldout_stems"],
                 st["n_rot_ops"], st["n_frozen_ops"], st["n_heldout_ops"], held_stems, held_ops))
        print("  POLARITY (re-parsed from disk): %s · balanced_exact=%s · chance_majority=%.4f "

        print("  0-SHOT ✅ held-out stem/operator names appear 0x in the corpus (exact-token: every "
              "name is 5 ascii chars, space-delimited, reserved-literal colliders dropped from the pool)")
        print("  strata: " + " · ".join("%s n=%d chance=%.4f"
                                        % (k, v["n"], v["chance_majority"])

        print("  manifests -> %s (%d eval items · 5 strata) · %s (polarity audit) · %s (%d "
              "store-lane rows) · %s (floor)"
              % (ej, len(st["manifest"]["entries"]), aj, sl + ".store.jsonl",
                 len(st["store_rows"]), mj))
        print("  score:  anima-py evaluate <clm> --decl-flip %s" % ej)
        return 0

## ② 정식화
s⁺ = s(v,g) · s⁻ = s(−v,g) (−v 는 **대수적 부정** — H_9773 ② 항등식 v_flip ≡ −v · h 재인코딩 금지). Π = byte 103↔98 교환 순열.
- out[c∉{g,b}] = λ·½(s⁺[c]+s⁻[c]) — even (극성-안정 scaffold, 수위 보존)
- out[g] = λ·½(s⁺[g]+s⁻[b]) · out[b] = λ·½(s⁺[b]+s⁻[g])
성질(산술): (i) margin out[g]−out[b] = λ·m_odd, m_odd = ½[(s⁺[g]−s⁺[b])−(s⁻[g]−s⁻[b])] — **정확히 odd**. (ii) pair 수위 ½(out[g]+out[b]) = λ·E (even 평균) — full-row odd 처럼 빼지 않고 **보존** ⟹ H_9744 에서 g/b 가 in-vivo argmax 였던 그 수위가 유지된다(readability 는 보장이 아니라 **측정 DV**). (iii) out(−v) = Π·out(v) — 배선 주장(극성반전⟺답교환)이 정확한 대칭으로 성립.

//  @version v1.0.0 🔵 SUPPORTED-FORMAL — B-HEXAD 5/5 (σ(6)=12 / φ(6)=2 / 11-step) · see /VERSIONS.md
//  HEXAD/hexad.hexa — top-level integration entry (single-forward 6-module)
//
//  PURPOSE
//    Canonical hexa-native ENTRY for the integrated 6-module Hexad. Declares:
//      • σ(6) = 12 inter-module connection map
//      • φ(6) = 2 gradient partition (group A CE-trained / group G frozen)
//      • forward graph spec: S → C → Bridge.detach → D, with M/W/E observers
//      • cross-link to per-module entries (HEXAD/{C,D,S,W,M,E,BRIDGE}/...)
//
//    Per-module selftests are run STANDALONE:
//        hexa run HEXAD/S/s.hexa          (B-S 3/3)
//        hexa run HEXAD/M/m.hexa          (B-M 3/3)
//        hexa run HEXAD/W/w.hexa          (B-W 4/4)
//        hexa run HEXAD/E/e.hexa          (B-E 4/4)
//        hexa run HEXAD/BRIDGE/bridge.hexa  (Law 70 clamp)
//        hexa run HEXAD/C/c.hexa          (scaffold invariants)
//        hexa run HEXAD/D/d.hexa          (scaffold invariants)
//
//    Single-process cross-module execution is NOW WIRED (TODO[wire] RESOLVED):
//    HEXAD/hexad_forward.hexa runs the σ6 graph S → C → Bridge.detach() → D
//    (M/W/E observers) as ONE deterministic call → a real N=6 module-activation
//    vector (the OMEGA w5 source). The namespace-collision blocker (`_approx_eq`
//    etc. shared across the per-module ENTRY files) was removed by the
//    `*_lib.hexa` split (module-prefixed private helpers). Honest carve-out
//    (a_core_engine_map): the byte MOUTH (D byte-logits decode) stays ckpt-gated
//    (570 MB 24L) — the engine `generate` slot is the honest STUB; the
//    module-activation `forward` slot is NATIVE. Proof: HEXAD/hexad_forward_smoke.hexa
//    12/12 + engines/engine_swap_smoke.hexa 27/27 (.verdicts/hexad-wire/).
//
//    Existing verified INTEGRATION evidence (Python tier):
//      state/verify_hexad_integ_2026_05_16/integ_harness.py
//      → F-INTEG-1..5  5/5 SUPPORTED-STRONG  (PR #77, fire_gate=true)
//
//  STATUS
//    🔵 spec + invariant declaration + executable σ6 cross-module forward
//       (HEXAD/hexad_forward.hexa — module-activation `forward` NATIVE; byte
//       MOUTH `generate` = honest ckpt-gated STUB, a_core_engine_map).
//
//  COMPLIANCE
//    raw#11 snake_case · raw#9/10 honest impl (no false integration claim)
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════


// ── σ(6) = 12 inter-module connection map ───────────────────────────────────
// 6 modules choose pairs = C(6,2) = 15 possible; σ(6) = 12 invariant identifies
// the ACTIVE connections (the 3 NOT included are documented as inactive).
//
//   active 12 connections (HEXAD-*.tape consistent):
//     S→C   C→Bridge   Bridge→D   M↔C   W↔C   W↔D (LR mod)
//     E↔C   E→W (gate) E→D (gate) D→loss  M↔D (retrieve)  S↔W (sense→pain)
//
//   inactive 3 (φ(6)=2 partition isolation):
//     S↔E (no direct sense→ethics)
//     M↔W (no direct memory→will)
//     S↔M (no direct sense→memory)
fn hexad_sigma6_connections() {
    return [
        "S→C", "C→Bridge", "Bridge→D",
        "M↔C", "W↔C", "W↔D",
        "E↔C", "E→W", "E→D",
        "D→loss", "M↔D", "S↔W"
    ]
}

fn hexad_sigma6_count() -> int { return 12 }


// ── φ(6) = 2 gradient partition ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// Group A (CE-trained / 좌뇌 / φ(6) group A): D, M, E + Bridge
// Group G (gradient-free / 우뇌 / φ(6) group G): C, S, W
fn hexad_group_a_ce_trained() {
    return ["D", "M", "E", "BRIDGE"]
}

fn hexad_group_g_gradient_free() {
    return ["C", "S", "W"]
}

fn hexad_phi6_groups() -> int { return 2 }


// ── forward graph spec (single-forward integration) ─────────────────────────
// S → C → Bridge.detach() → D
// M (retrieve/store alongside C)
// W (lr modulate; observes Φ + loss)
// E (ethics gate; observes Φ; can BLOCK train step if phi_preservation < ½)
fn hexad_forward_steps() {
    return [
        "1. S.process(raw) → tension",
        "2. C.step(tension) → cell-pool evolved",
        "3. c_states = C.get_states().detach()  // Law 53 gradient barrier",
        "4. M.retrieve(c_states, top_k) → memories (parallel)",
        "5. M.store(c_states, c_states)        // Hebbian no-op",
        "6. gate = Bridge(c_states)             // Law 70 PSI clamp",
        "7. logits = D(tokens, consciousness_states=cs)",
        "8. phi = C.measure_phi()",
        "9. W.update(loss, phi, phi_prev) → effective_lr",
        "10. E.evaluate(phi, phi_prev)  → allowed (gate)",
        "11. backward(loss): D + Bridge ONLY (φ(6)=2 group A)"
    ]
}


// ── per-module entry path map (for human + tooling reference) ───────────────
fn hexad_module_entries() {
    return #{
        "C": "HEXAD/C/c.hexa",
        "D": "HEXAD/D/d.hexa",
        "S": "HEXAD/S/s.hexa",
        "M": "HEXAD/M/m.hexa",
        "W": "HEXAD/W/w.hexa",
        "E": "HEXAD/E/e.hexa",
        "BRIDGE": "HEXAD/BRIDGE/bridge.hexa"
    }
}


// ── module verdict status (mirrors HEXAD/README.md table) ───────────────────
fn hexad_verdict_status() {
    return #{
        "C":      "🔵 (.clm v1 8/8 + F-PYPHI, MITOSIS.tape)",
        "S":      "🔵 B-S 3/3 closed (sympy)",
        "M":      "🔵 B-M 3/3 closed (sympy)",
        "W":      "🔵 B-W 4/4 closed (sympy)",
        "E":      "🔵 B-E 4/4 closed (sympy)",
        "D":      "🔵 B-D 4/4 closed (sympy; PR #76 honest decomposition)",
        "BRIDGE": "🔵 Law 70 clamp closed (Ψ ± 0.014)",
        "TOTAL":  "6/6 full 🔵 SUPPORTED-FORMAL + 통합 harness 5/5 SUPPORTED-STRONG fire-gate=true"
    }
}


// ── helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn _h_has(name: string, items) -> bool {
    let i = 0
    while i < len(items) {
        if to_string(items[i]) == name { return true }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return false
}


// ── selftest: integration-spec invariant checks (NOT a functional run) ──────
fn _selftest() {
    // σ(6) = 12 connection count invariant
    let conns = hexad_sigma6_connections()
    let sigma_ok = len(conns) == hexad_sigma6_count()
    print("  σ(6)=12 active connections   : " + to_string(sigma_ok)
          + "  (declared=" + to_string(len(conns)) + ")")

    // φ(6) = 2 partition invariant (A + G = {6 modules + Bridge})
    let ga = hexad_group_a_ce_trained()
    let gg = hexad_group_g_gradient_free()
    let partition_ok = (len(ga) + len(gg)) == 7   // 4 CE-trained + 3 gradient-free + (Bridge in A)
                        && _h_has("C", gg) && _h_has("S", gg) && _h_has("W", gg)
                        && _h_has("D", ga) && _h_has("M", ga) && _h_has("E", ga)
                        && _h_has("BRIDGE", ga)
    print("  φ(6)=2 partition A/G split    : " + to_string(partition_ok))

    // forward graph step count (sanity: 11 steps spec)
    let steps = hexad_forward_steps()
    let steps_ok = len(steps) == 11
    print("  forward graph spec steps==11 : " + to_string(steps_ok))

    // module entries dict complete (all 7)
    let entries = hexad_module_entries()
    let entries_ok = to_string(entries["C"])     != "void"
                      && to_string(entries["D"])      != "void"
                      && to_string(entries["S"])      != "void"
                      && to_string(entries["M"])      != "void"
                      && to_string(entries["W"])      != "void"
                      && to_string(entries["E"])      != "void"
                      && to_string(entries["BRIDGE"]) != "void"
    print("  7 module entries declared    : " + to_string(entries_ok))

    // verdict status all 🔵 — mirror HEXAD/README.md
    let v = hexad_verdict_status()
    let verdict_ok = to_string(v["TOTAL"]) != "void"
    print("  verdict status TOTAL line    : " + to_string(verdict_ok))

    let all_ok = sigma_ok && partition_ok && steps_ok && entries_ok && verdict_ok
    print("=== HEXAD/hexad.hexa spec invariants: " + to_string(all_ok) + " ===")
    print("    canonical 🔵 sympy : blue_falsifier.py B-HEXAD-1..5 (σ(6)=12 conn / φ(6)=2 partition cover / 11-step forward / 7-entries / TOTAL record)")
    print("                          sympy lift of above 5 runtime invariants (g_verdict_tier_blue tier-a, real-limit Kolmogorov+set-cover)")
}


fn main() {
    print("HEXAD — anima 6-module hexa-native canonical integration entry")
    print("σ(6)=12 inter-module connections · φ(6)=2 gradient groups")
    print("forward: S → C → Bridge.detach → D  (with M/W/E observers)")
    print("verified evidence: 6/6 full 🔵 + 통합 harness 5/5 SUPPORTED-STRONG fire-gate=true (PR #77)")
    _selftest()
    print("")
    print("per-module selftest entries (standalone):")
    let e = hexad_module_entries()
    print("  C      : " + to_string(e["C"]))
    print("  D      : " + to_string(e["D"]))
    print("  S      : " + to_string(e["S"]))
    print("  M      : " + to_string(e["M"]))
    print("  W      : " + to_string(e["W"]))
    print("  E      : " + to_string(e["E"]))
    print("  BRIDGE : " + to_string(e["BRIDGE"]))
}

# H_9807 — INTERVENTIONAL CLOSURE LADDER (rung 1): 자기 입력에 대한 contingency 지문을 yoked-ghost 대비로 측정하는 개입형 계기  **tier:** 🔵 계기 IMPLEMENTED + toy e2e 통과 · NOT a verdict (기질 미측정 · 대상은 스크립트 plant 뿐) **group:** R12-interventional-instrument **source:** lab/v3 캠페인(H_011 stage-A 인증 계기 + H_013 root-cause 수리)의 생산 이식. lab 은 규칙-면제 샌드박스 ⟹ 그 숫자는 절대 생산 주장이 아니다. **wired:** yes (`anima-py evaluate --closure-ladder`) **verdict:** 계기 CERTIFIED (3-plant 배터리 통과) · 기질 판정 PENDING  ## claim  에이전트의 **CONTINGENCY STRUCTURE**(행동 marginal 이 아니라 *순서/조건부 구조*)가 **자기 자신의 다음 입력**의 분포에 지문을 남기는가 — marginal 을 맞춘 Watson **yoked-ghost**(자기 행동을 그대로, 순서만 파괴한 replay)를 바닥으로 두고 측정한다. 실행 행동이 {진짜 행동, marginal-matched shuffle} 위의 seeded coin 으로 **A/B 무작위화** 되므로 P(I_{t+1} | do(A_t)) 가 **식별**된다 ⟹ 이 레포에서 유일하게 **상관이 아니라 anchor** 할 수 있는 렌즈.  ## ⚠️ rung 1 은 aliveness 가 아니다 (이 카드의 가장 중요한 문장)  - **온도조절기가 통과한다.** 여기 실린 스크립트 plant P-LIVE(15줄 항상성 정책)는 **설계상 반드시** 통과해야 한다. 
# H_9808 — PRE-REGISTRATION GATES: four $0 referees that REFUSE a doomed spend before it happens  > **tier**: 🔵 INSTRUMENT LANDED · TOY e2e PASS · **NOT a verdict** (no 303M fire, not even DIRECTIONAL) > **id**: H_9808 · **date**: 2026-07-20 · **cost**: $0 (closed-form, stdlib-only, no forward pass) > **surfaces**: this card + ONE line in `HYPOTHESES/HYPOTHESES.jsonl`. Nothing else.  ## What this is  Four **admissibility referees** absorbed from the `lab/v4` and `lab/v5` campaigns into production `anima-py`. Each one is a gate that **would have refused a spend that actually happened**, and none of them existed here: `trained-control-ceiling` had **0 hits** in `HYPOTHESES.jsonl` and **0 hits** in `ARCHITECTURE.json` before this card.  They decide **admissibility, never a verdict**. A gate PASS is not a result, is not DIRECTIONAL, and does not predict that the run it admits will be green. It says only: *the number this run produces will be capable of carrying a bit.*  ## Why an admissibility gate is not optional (the measured bill)

# H_9813 — serialize-parity + GN 비인과 누출 계기  **status:** 🔑 계기 착륙 + 2 실측 확정 (직렬화 무죄 · forward 비인과 0.5964 nat) · **DIRECTIONAL** **wired:** yes — `anima-py train --serialize-parity <panel.json>` (학습기가 torch 모델과 방금 쓴 `.clm` 을 동시에 쥔 유일한 자리 · 진단 예외 격리로 학습을 죽이지 않음) **source:** [[H_9811]] 사다리의 모순 — 학습측 `ans_ce` 0.0001 vs 저장본 d_acc 0.5000  ## 계기 (두 팔)  1. **serialize-parity** — 같은 접두사·같은 2AFC 를 torch 모델과 `.clm` 디코드 양 경로로 채점,    선택 일치율을 보고. 손실 구간이 "학습→저장" 인지 가른다. 2. **GN 누출 팔** — **첫 답 바이트**의 예측은 인과적으로 답 바이트들에 의존할 수 없다.    같은 창을 입력-답-존재 vs 입력-답-마스킹(타깃 불변)으로 두 번 forward 해 그 위치 NLL 비교.    Δ ≠ 0 이면 예측 위치 **이후**의 입력이 예측을 움직인 것 = forward 비인과 증명.  ## 실측 (K=2 길이-매칭 패널 · d64 L6 3600step seed7 · n=32/16)  | 측정 | 값 | 독해 | 
# H_9814 — 비인과 GN 버스를 닫으면 결합이 학습되는가 (per-position norm 대조 · 사전등록)  **status:** 🔒 PRE-REGISTERED (판정표 동결 · 실행 전 커밋) · **DIRECTIONAL-SCREEN 상한** **wired:** yes(계기) — `anima-py train --trunk-norm {global,position}` · 채점은 `--serialize-parity` 의 torch 팔 (⚠️ `.clm` 디코드는 GLOBAL 의미론이라 position ckpt 의 engine-native 채점은 디코드 레인이 서기 전까지 의미상 오류 — torch 수치는 영구 SCREEN) **source:** [[H_9813]] — forward 비인과 0.5964 nat 실측. 남은 물음: 그 채널을 **닫으면** 결합(gold = hp XOR pos)이 학습되는가, 아니면 벽은 딴 데 있는가.  ## 개입 — 한 변수  `PerPositionGroupNorm` (core/model.py): 같은 affine 파라미터·같은 state_dict 배치, 정규화 통계만 **위치별**로 계산 ⟹ 미래 바이트가 과거 위치로 흐를 채널이 **구성적으로 없음**.  **고정 조건**: K=2 길이-매칭 패널(누수 0 인증) · `--answer-ce-weight 0` (오염 항 미사용) · d=64 · L=6(RF 127B≥74B) · 3600 step · seq 96 · batch 8 · seed 7. **한 변수 = `--trunk-norm`.**  ## 🔒 판정표 (데이터 보기 전 동결) 
# H_9815 — 이 토이는 아무것도 못 배우는가, 합성만 못 하는가 (양성 통제 · 사전등록)  **status:** 🔒 PRE-REGISTERED (판정표 동결 · 실행 전 커밋) · **DIRECTIONAL** (토이) **wired:** yes — `anima-py corpus bindpanel --bind-task {xor,hp}` · 채점 = `--serialize-parity` torch 팔 (같은 2AFC · 우연 0.5) **source:** [[H_9814]] SCREEN-NEGATIVE + 오너 "both go". [[H_9811]]~[[H_9814]] 가 배관 축 (복잡도·수용영역·목적가중·정규화)을 전부 죽였는데 토이는 여전히 우연 — **양성 통제 없이 읽은 음성은 판독 불가**(`positive-control-before-reading-a-negative`).  ## 물음  `gold = hp XOR pos`(합성 필요)를 못 맞히는 이 토이가, `gold = hp`(국소 자질 하나)는 맞히는가?  - **못 맞힌다** ⟹ 배관/기질이 죽은 것. 이 계보의 **모든 음성이 무효**가 된다. - **맞힌다** ⟹ 국소 자질은 학습된다. 실패는 **합성(재조합)에 국한** — 이 4 kB 토이가   이 저장소가 몇 달째 부딪히는 **재조합 벽의 국소 인스턴스**가 된다(303M 을 태우지 않고   같은 벽을 손에 쥐는 것).  
# H_9816 — 쓰기측 긴장 場이 합성을 들어올리는가 (선별기 위 3-모드 스크린 · 사전등록)  **status:** 🔒 PRE-REGISTERED (판정표 동결 · 실행 전 커밋) · **DIRECTIONAL-SCREEN** (토이·torch) **wired:** yes — `anima-py train --tension-field {duel,rank1} --tension-concord {class,lex,morph}` · 채점 = `--serialize-parity` torch 2AFC **source:** [[H_9815]] 가 선별기를 살려냈다(hp 1.0000 = 배관·채점·직렬화 생존 증명, xor 0.4062 = 합성만 실패). # H_9817 — 재조합 벽은 표현력 벽인가 최적화 벽인가 (그로킹 레짐 스크린 · 사전등록)  **status:** 🔒 PRE-REGISTERED (판정표 동결 · 실행 전 커밋) · **DIRECTIONAL-SCREEN 상한** (토이 · torch 측) **wired:** yes — 신규 코드 **0줄**. 기존 플래그만: `anima-py train --steps N --wd-floor W` · 채점 = `--serialize-parity` 의 torch 2AFC 팔 (H_9813 계기) **source:** [[H_9815]] — 4 kB 토이가 재조합 벽을 국소 재현(hp 1.0000 vs xor 0.4062). [[H_9811]]~[[H_9814]] 가 배관·수용영역·정규화·목적가중·채점·직렬화를 전부 배제한 자리.  ## 재프레임 (이 H 의 존재 이유)  이 계보는 벽을 줄곧 **구조/표현력** 축에서 찾아왔다(정규화·수용영역·場·binder lane). 그런데 표현력 논증을 다시 세우면 그 전제가 성립하지 않는다:  **`XOR(hp, pos)` 는 곱셈 원시연산 없이도 표현 가능하다.** 두 자질의 **합**이 {0,1,2} 중 정확히 1일 때만 참이므로, 합에 **비단조 함수** 하나만 얹으면 계산된다 — GELU 6층 몸통이 원리적으로 그릴 수 있는 함수다(수용영역 안에 두 자질이 들어오기만 하면 되고, H_9814 가 RF 127 B ≥ 74 B 로 이미 확인했다).  
# H_9819 — 상전이점을 지표로 삼아 3600-step 음성들을 재심한다 (사전등록)  **status:** 🔒 PRE-REGISTERED (판정표 동결 · 실행 전 커밋) · **DIRECTIONAL-SCREEN 상한** (토이·torch) **wired:** yes — 신규 코드 0줄. `anima-py train --steps N --tension-field … --tension-concord …` · 채점 = `--serialize-parity` torch 2AFC 팔 **source:** [[H_9817]] GROKKING BREAK — 이 토이의 합성 학습은 **7200~14400 사이에서 상전이**하며, [[H_9816]]·[[H_9814]]·[[H_9811]] 이 판정을 낸 3600 step 은 **그 아래**다.  ## 왜 지표를 바꿔야 하는가 (설계상 강제된 변경)  재심의 자연스러운 형태는 "같은 팔을 상전이 위(≥28800)에서 다시 재기" 지만, 그 예산에서 **기준선(場 없음)이 이미 1.0000**([[H_9817]] seed 7)이라 **천장에 막혀 어떤 상승도 측정 불가**다. 같은 자를 그대로 쓰면 모든 팔이 1.0000 로 붙어 "차이 없음" 이 나오는데, 그건 **레버가 무력해서가 아니라 지표가 포화**해서다 — 그렇게 낸 음성은 3600 음성과 똑같은 종류의 판독 불가다.  ⟹ **DV 를 바꾼다: 고정 예산의 d_acc → 우연을 탈출하는 step(전이점).** 천장이 사라지고, "場이 합성을 연다" 는 주장이 **"場이 전이를 앞당긴다"** 라는 측정 가능한 형태가 된다. 이 자는 이 계보의 **모든** 레버에 동일하게 적용된다([[H_9818]] 커리큘럼 포함).

            # target_slot) so ∂L/∂v is not gated on the softmax lookup bootstrapping first. Separates the
            # value-read layer (a) from the address-learning layer (c): if val differentiates under free
            # address (ORACLE≥.90) the residual 303M wall is pure W_q address-learning; if not, deeper.
            osl = tgt if sb_oracle else None

            # never pushes the trunk through this path ⇒ no EN-occupancy competition). None ⇒ W_q(yn_q).
            # H_9720 C2 detach-ablation: 'detached' (default) = store-CE never reaches the trunk through
            # this tap (disjoint · the CRACK arm) · 'shared' = drop .detach() so store-CE DOES flow into

            else:

            store_logits, att = model.clms(yn_q, K, pols, oracle_slot=osl, need_att=True,
                                           yn_fresh=yn_fresh)   # (Bs,V),(Bs,n_slot)
            ce_ans = F.cross_entropy(store_logits, y_s[:, Ts - 1])
            # non-answer trunk CE (prompt spelling): every row but qpos, standard next-byte LM.

            loss = loss + ce_tok + sb_w * ce_ans + out_s["aux_loss"]

            if sb_addr_w > 0.0:

            # H_9691 RV-1 oracle-aux dual-path: ALSO train the value/MLP path on the ORACLE (correct one-hot)
            # address every step. The softmax branch (above) trains W_q; this branch replays Stage1.5's proven
            # signal (correct v → MLP learns the XOR function). Runs simultaneously so the race that left val
            # seed-fragile under addr-loss alone (seed-7 won, seed-11 lost to the op-only basin — RV-0: val WAS
            # differentiated, so it is a FUNCTIONAL failure of the fusion) is dissolved. Skipped when already
            # oracle (osl==tgt → identical). 0 → byte-identical.
    class CLMSModule(_nn.Module):
        """Learnable co-trained store-bridge lane. Trains {W_q, val, W_h(+bias), W_out, lam}; key_emb is
        a FROZEN buffer (never a parameter — no grad, not in the optimizer). K_slots is NOT a parameter:
        the store is runtime-injected. forward(yn_q:(B,d), K:(B,n_slot,d_k), pols:(B,n_slot),
        oracle_slot=None) -> (B,V) = lam·store_logits. Op order MIRRORS core/clms.store_apply 6–14
        exactly for 2-production parity. The caller overwrites logits[b, qpos] = forward(...) and takes
        CE — the module emits ONLY store_logits, so the trunk logit never receives answer-position grad
        (② shortcut-cut is structural, not a regulariser)."""

        def __init__(self, d, V, n_slot=8, d_k=64, d_s=64, r=128,
                     key_seed=9423, key_emb=None, lam0=1.0, d_g=64, val_center=False, fangate=False,
                     fresh_k=0, fresh_L=3):
            super().__init__()
            self.d, self.V, self.n_slot = d, V, n_slot
            self.d_k, self.d_s, self.r, self.key_seed = d_k, d_s, r, key_seed
            self.d_g = d_g                                          # H_9423 fusion-bottleneck (lane_type 2)
            self.val_center = bool(val_center)                     # RV-3 majority-null centering (lane_type 3)
            self.fangate = bool(fangate)                           # H_9696 CLMS-FAN (lane_type 4)
            # H_9720-ⓐ EN-disjoint fresh query lane (lane_type 5): the ADDRESS query is read from an
            # early-layer tap (detached from the trunk in the trainer) through W_fresh·W_q_fresh — store-CE
            # co-adapts an entity basis that does NOT compete with EN-CE for the penultimate. fresh_k=0 =
            # off = every existing lane byte-identical (nothing packed, forward unchanged).
            self.fresh_k, self.fresh_L = int(fresh_k), int(fresh_L)
            self.scale = 1.0 / (d_k ** 0.5)
            if key_emb is None:
                ke = (np.random.RandomState(key_seed).standard_normal((256, d_k))
                      * (1.0 / np.sqrt(d_k))).astype("<f4")
            else:
                ke = np.asarray(key_emb, dtype="<f4")
            self.register_buffer("key_emb", _torch.from_numpy(ke.copy()), persistent=True)
            self.W_q = _nn.Linear(d, d_k, bias=False)
            if self.fresh_k > 0:                                   # H_9720-ⓐ fresh query lane params
                self.W_fresh = _nn.Linear(d, self.fresh_k, bias=False)      # tap(d) → fresh_k
                self.W_q_fresh = _nn.Linear(self.fresh_k, d_k, bias=False)  # fresh_k → d_k address
            # H_9423 value-read fix: yn_q enters the fusion MLP through a learned bottleneck W_g:d→d_g
            # (op is ~1 bit; d_g=64 suffices) so the store value v (d_s) is not diluted 59× against the
            # raw d=3784 penultimate. Restores the toy [v64;g64] fusion geometry d_model-invariantly —
            # the S2 both-arm ORACLE-death (0.47/0.49) was v drowned in [v; yn_q] at d=3784.
            self.W_g = _nn.Linear(d, d_g, bias=False)
            self.val = _nn.Parameter(_torch.randn(2, d_s) * 0.02)
            if self.fangate:
                # H_9696: free ideation has no polarity — the value is projected from the slot's OWN
                # key (W_v), and a learned data-dependent gate (W_gate) replaces the "=> " literal.
                # `val` stays allocated but is UNUSED on this lane (and is not packed).
                self.W_v = _nn.Linear(d_k, d_s, bias=False)
                self.W_gate = _nn.Linear(d, 1, bias=False)
            self.W_h = _nn.Linear(d_s + d_g, r)
            self.W_out = _nn.Linear(r, V, bias=False)
            self.lam = _nn.Parameter(_torch.tensor(float(lam0)))   # monitor-only scalar (no loss term)

        def entity_keys(self, entities):
            """(n_slot, d_k) content-addresses for a list of entity names — same formula as numpy
            _entity_key (mean of the frozen per-byte rows). Trainer builds K per block-store with this."""
            rows = []
            for e in entities:
                ids = _torch.tensor(list(e.encode("ascii")), dtype=_torch.long, device=self.key_emb.device)
                rows.append(self.key_emb[ids].mean(dim=0))
            return _torch.stack(rows)

        def forward(self, yn_q, K, pols, oracle_slot=None, need_att=False, yn_fresh=None):
            # yn_q:(B,d) query-position penultimate · K:(B,n_slot,d_k) · pols:(B,n_slot) in {0,1}
            # yn_fresh:(B,d) H_9720-ⓐ early-layer tap (trainer detaches it); when present + fresh_k>0 the
            # ADDRESS query comes from the disjoint fresh lane, but yn_q STILL drives the W_g op-gate below.
            if self.fresh_k > 0 and yn_fresh is not None:
                q = self.W_q_fresh(_F.gelu(self.W_fresh(yn_fresh), approximate="tanh"))  # (B,d_k)
            else:
                q = self.W_q(yn_q)                                        # (B,d_k)
            att = _torch.bmm(K, q.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1) * self.scale  # (B,n_slot) address logits
            if oracle_slot is not None:
                a = _F.one_hot(oracle_slot, self.n_slot).to(q.dtype)      # (B,n_slot) softmax bypassed
            else:
                a = _torch.softmax(att, dim=-1)

            if self.val_center:                                           # RV-3 majority-null centering (H_9710)
                a = a - (1.0 / self.n_slot)                               # v≡0 at uniform a → shortcut basin gone
            v = _torch.bmm(a.unsqueeze(1), V_slots).squeeze(1)           # (B,d_s)
            g = self.W_g(yn_q)                                            # (B,d_g) op-gate bottleneck
            z = _F.gelu(self.W_h(_torch.cat([v, g], dim=-1)), approximate="tanh")   # (B,r) [v; g] fusion
            s = self.W_out(z)                                             # (B,V)
            if self.fangate:
                s = _torch.sigmoid(self.W_gate(yn_q)) * s                 # (B,1)*(B,V) learned gate
            out = self.lam * s
            # H_9672 addr-loss: expose the pre-softmax address logits so the trainer can supervise them
            # (L_addr = CE(att, target_slot)). att is computed regardless of oracle_slot, so oracle-train
            # + addr-loss compose. need_att=False → byte-identical to the prior single-return signature.
            return (out, att) if need_att else out
    t_list = []
    for t in range(2, len(tok)):

    return t_list


def _entity_key(key_emb, entity):
    """Content address for an entity name = mean of the frozen per-byte embedding rows. Generalizes to
    held-out entities (a new key built from seen bytes). key_emb is (256, d_k)."""
    ids = np.frombuffer(entity.encode("ascii"), dtype=np.uint8)
    return key_emb[ids].mean(axis=0)


def store_apply(logits, yn, clms, store, qpos, oracle=False, lam_override=None, audit=None,
                query="qpos", fuse="overwrite", fresh_yn=None):
    """CLMS store-bridge lane: OVERWRITE the answer-position logits row with λ·store_logits.

    query/fuse (H_9695 R3 · the read→mouth wiring the G6 angles need · defaults reproduce the
    H_9423 lane byte-for-byte):
      query="qpos"        — fire only where find_qpos hits the literal "=> " trigram (H_9423).
      query="every-token" — fire at EVERY row. The literal trigram cannot exist in free ideation,
                            so a G6-facing lane must be able to query without a marker. Note the
                            marker is not merely absent in free generation: teaching the mouth to
                            emit "=> " itself would be kill #1's scaffold moved inside the mouth,
                            which is why the legal form is a learned gate (H_9696), not a literal.
      fuse="overwrite"    — out[t] = λ·s (H_9423 store_only gate: the structural shortcut-cut that
                            makes the storebind readout attributable to the lane alone).
      fuse="gated-add"    — out[t] = logits[t] + λ·s. Overwriting EVERY row would delete the trunk
                            and destroy fluency (dist<5 kills the ρ·fan panel before bind can be
                            read); additive keeps the lane a perturbation whose CONTENT-dependence
                            is what the scramble controls test.

    logits : (T, V) float — readout(+CLML) logits. The caller's array is NOT mutated (internal copy).
    yn     : (T, d) float — pre-slot trunk penultimate (= _fwd_trunk output = yn_trunk, the SAME tap
             CLML reads; NOT the SLW-modified penultimate).
    clms   : dict from read_clms (key_emb, W_q, val, W_h, b_h, W_out, lam, n_slot, d_k, d_s, r).
    store  : {"entities": [str]*n_slot, "pols": [int in {0,1}]*n_slot, "target_slot": int|None}.
             target_slot is used only when oracle=True.
    qpos   : list of int from find_qpos(tok).
    oracle : True => bypass the softmax lookup, a = one_hot(target_slot) (C0-e positive control:
             hands the lookup for free, so ORACLE<0.90 = the value/MLP/λ/serialization plumbing is
             dead, independent of whether addressing can be learned — read no negative before it passes).
    lam_override : None = file λ · 0.0 = λ0 control (C2, byte-identical passthrough) · 1.0 = store_only.

    Passthrough (returns logits unchanged): clms None · lane_type==0 · store None · λ==0 · and
    (query="qpos" only) qpos empty. query="every-token" does NOT require qpos — free ideation
    contains no "=> " by construction, so gating the marker-free lane on the marker would silence
    it exactly where it is meant to fire (H_9695).
    Op order is IDENTICAL to CLMSModule.forward (2-production parity)."""
    if clms is None or int(clms.get("lane_type", 0)) == 0 or store is None:
        return logits
    if query == "qpos" and not qpos:
        return logits
    lam = float(clms["lam"]) if lam_override is None else float(lam_override)
    if lam == 0.0:
        return logits
    dt = logits.dtype
    n_slot = int(clms["n_slot"])
    key_emb = clms["key_emb"]
    ents = store["entities"]
    pols = np.asarray(store["pols"], dtype=np.int64)
    K = np.stack([_entity_key(key_emb, ents[i]) for i in range(n_slot)])   # (n_slot, d_k)
    lane_type = int(clms.get("lane_type", 1))
    if lane_type == 4:
        # H_9696 CLMS-FAN: free ideation carries no polarity, so the value cannot be val[pols]. The
        # slot's value is projected out of the slot's OWN key — the lane retrieves "which word I am
        # holding is relevant here" and re-injects its identity = the mouth-internal binding operator
        # H_1603 names as the shared missing part of both walls.
        V_slots = K @ clms["W_v"]                                          # (n_slot, d_s)
    else:
        V_slots = clms["val"][pols]                                        # (n_slot, d_s)
    scale = 1.0 / np.sqrt(float(clms["d_k"]))
    out = logits.copy()
    if query == "every-token":
        rows = range(len(yn))          # H_9695: marker-free — the lane queries at every position
    elif query == "qpos":
        rows = qpos
    else:
        raise ValueError("store_apply: query must be 'qpos' or 'every-token' (got %r)" % query)
    if fuse not in ("overwrite", "gated-add", "odd", "pairodd"):
        raise ValueError("store_apply: fuse must be 'overwrite', 'gated-add', 'odd' or 'pairodd' (got %r)" % fuse)
    for t in rows:
        h = yn[t]                                                          # (d,)
        if lane_type == 5:                                                 # H_9720-ⓐ fresh query lane
            hf = (fresh_yn[t] if fresh_yn is not None else h)              # early-layer tap (decode supplies it)
            q = _gelu(hf @ clms["W_fresh"]) @ clms["W_q_fresh"]           # (d_k,) disjoint address query
        else:
            q = h @ clms["W_q"]                                           # (d_k,) [row-vector conv, CLML-form]
        if oracle:
            a = np.zeros(n_slot, dtype=q.dtype)
            a[int(store["target_slot"])] = 1.0                            # softmax bypassed (address free)
        else:
            a = _softmax(q @ K.T * scale)                                # (n_slot,) content-address lookup
        if audit is not None:                                            # H_9672 addr-audit (None=byte-identical)
            ts = store.get("target_slot")
            # H_9802 store-telemetry: `a_max`/`a_ent` are TARGET-FREE, so they stay meaningful on
            # natural text where no target_slot exists (a_target degenerates to -1 there). They
            # split the two failure modes the H_9802 pre-check must tell apart BEFORE any training
            # spend: a_max ≈ 1/n_slot (uniform) ⟹ natural text never ADDRESSES the store
            # (recruitment problem); a_max ≫ 1/n_slot with wrong values ⟹ it addresses but the
            # values are garbage (alignment problem). a_ent is the entropy of the address
            # distribution normalised by log(n_slot), so 1.0 = uniform and 0.0 = a hard one-slot
            # hit — both read against the DERIVED uniform baseline, never an assumed chance.
            # MONITOR-ONLY (a_train_inline_gauge): never enters any loss or any frozen bar.
            _p = a / (a.sum() + 1e-12)
            _ent = float(-(_p * np.log(_p + 1e-12)).sum() / (np.log(n_slot) + 1e-12))
            audit.append({"argmax": int(np.argmax(a)),
                          "a_target": float(a[int(ts)]) if ts is not None else -1.0,
                          "target": int(ts) if ts is not None else -1,
                          "a_max": float(np.max(a)),
                          "a_ent": _ent})
        if lane_type == 3:                                                # RV-3 majority-null centering (H_9710)
            a = a - (1.0 / n_slot)                                        # v≡0 at uniform a → shortcut basin gone
        v = a @ V_slots                                                   # (d_s,) = Σ (aᵢ−c)·val[polᵢ]
        if lane_type in (2, 3, 4, 5):
            g = h @ clms["W_g"]                                           # (d_g,) op-gate bottleneck (H_9423)
            z = _gelu(np.concatenate([v, g]) @ clms["W_h"] + clms["b_h"]) # (r,) [v; g] fusion (v un-diluted)
        else:                                                             # lane_type 1 legacy: [v; h] fusion
            z = _gelu(np.concatenate([v, h]) @ clms["W_h"] + clms["b_h"]) # (r,) — S1/S2 artifacts, no silent recast
        s = z @ clms["W_out"]                                             # (V,)
        if fuse == "odd":                                                 # H_9760 odd-symmetrized fusion:
            v_neg = -v                                                    #   s_odd = ½(s(v,g) − s(−v,g)) cancels the
            if lane_type in (2, 3, 4, 5):                                 #   even (op-gate g-path) prior that emits a
                z_neg = _gelu(np.concatenate([v_neg, g]) @ clms["W_h"] + clms["b_h"])  # polarity-invariant constant on
            else:                                                         #   op=0 (H_9744 flip-coh gap). For lane_type 3
                z_neg = _gelu(np.concatenate([v_neg, h]) @ clms["W_h"] + clms["b_h"])  # (Σ(aᵢ−1/n)=0 ⟹ v_flip≡−v) this
            s = 0.5 * (s - z_neg @ clms["W_out"])                         #   makes fixed-address flip-coherence = 1.
        elif fuse == "pairodd":                                           # H_9775 Π-equivariant pair-odd: full-row odd
            v_neg = -v                                                    #   (H_9760) killed the g/b argmax because it
            if lane_type in (2, 3, 4, 5):                                 #   subtracted the even level that made g/b the
                z_neg = _gelu(np.concatenate([v_neg, g]) @ clms["W_h"] + clms["b_h"])  # top logits. Here out[c∉{g,b}]=
            else:                                                         #   ½(s⁺+s⁻) PRESERVES that even level (argmax
                z_neg = _gelu(np.concatenate([v_neg, h]) @ clms["W_h"] + clms["b_h"])  # stays g/b = readable) while
            s_neg = z_neg @ clms["W_out"]                                 #   swapping ONLY the answer pair makes the g/b
            G_BYTE, B_BYTE = 103, 98                                      #   margin exactly odd in store polarity (Π =
            sp_g, sp_b = float(s[G_BYTE]), float(s[B_BYTE])              #   103↔98 = the task's answer alphabet, not

// ── helpers: vector ops on flat lists ───────────────────────────────────────
fn _m_dot(a, b) -> float {
    let s = 0.0
    let i = 0
    while i < len(a) {
        s = s + a[i] * b[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    return s
}

fn _m_norm(a) -> float {
    let s = 0.0
    let i = 0
    while i < len(a) {
        s = s + a[i] * a[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let n = s
    // simple sqrt via Newton (3 iter, sufficient for selftest)
    let r = 1.0
    if n > 0.0 {
        let k = 0
        while k < 12 {
            r = 0.5 * (r + n / r)
            k = k + 1
        }
    } else {
        r = 0.0
    }
    return r
}

fn _m_cosine(a, b) -> float {
    let na = _m_norm(a)
    let nb = _m_norm(b)
    let denom = na * nb
    if denom <= 1e-12 { return 0.0 }
    return _m_dot(a, b) / denom
}


// ── m_retrieve_topk: cosine-similarity top-k indices (B-M-2 DETERMINISTIC) ──
// states: flat row-major (n × dim).  query: list of length dim.
// returns: list of top_k indices (0-based) sorted by descending similarity.
fn m_retrieve_topk(query, states, n: int, dim: int, top_k: int) {
    let sims = []
    let i = 0
    while i < n {
        let row = []
        let j = 0
        while j < dim {
            row = row + [states[i * dim + j]]
            j = j + 1
        }
        sims = sims + [_m_cosine(query, row)]
        i = i + 1
    }
    // selection sort top_k (small k expected)
    let chosen = []
    let used = []
    let u = 0
    while u < n {
        used = used + [false]
        u = u + 1
    }
    let k_done = 0
    let k_target = top_k
    if k_target > n { k_target = n }
    while k_done < k_target {
        let best = -1
        let best_v = -2.0
        let p = 0
        while p < n {
            if (used[p] == false) && (sims[p] > best_v) {
                best = p
                best_v = sims[p]
            }
            p = p + 1
        }
        if best < 0 { return chosen }
        chosen = chosen + [best]
        used[best] = true
        k_done = k_done + 1
    }
    return chosen
}


// ── m_retrieve_null: null constant fallback (B-M-3 NULL-CONSTANT) ───────────
fn m_retrieve_null(dim: int) {
    let z = []
    let i = 0
    while i < dim {
        z = z + [0.0]
        i = i + 1
    }
    return z
}

// ── mean of a flat value list (a scalar activation summary per module) ───────
fn _hf_mean(v: [float]) -> float {
    let n = len(v)
    if n == 0 { return 0.0 }
    let mut s = 0.0
    let mut i = 0
    while i < n {
        s = s + v[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    return s / (n * 1.0)
}

// ── copy a value list (the Bridge.detach() value barrier — Law 53) ───────────
// Group G state crossing into group A crosses as a COPY: no shared reference, no
// gradient path. This is the φ(6)=2 separation made operational.
fn _hf_detach_copy(v: [float]) -> [float] {
    let mut out = []
    let mut i = 0
    while i < len(v) {
        out = out + [v[i]]
        i = i + 1
    }
    return out
}

// ── S perception — column-mean(after) − column-mean(before) (B-S core) ───────
// The closed-form S core (Law 50: "감각 = C 의식의 상태 변화"). Reimplemented
// with codegen-safe `mut` counters (see import note). Returns the delta vector.
fn _hf_s_perception(before: [float], after: [float], n_cells: int, dim: int) -> [float] {
    let mut out = []
    let mut j = 0
    while j < dim {
        let mut sb = 0.0
        let mut sa = 0.0
        let mut i = 0
        while i < n_cells {
            sb = sb + before[i * dim + j]
            sa = sa + after[i * dim + j]
            i = i + 1
        }
        out = out + [(sa - sb) / (n_cells * 1.0)]
        j = j + 1
    }
    return out
}

// ── M retrieval — cosine top-1 index over the cell rows (B-M-2 core) ─────────
// Reimplements the B-M-2 DETERMINISTIC cosine top-k (top_k=1) with `mut`-safe
// loop bindings. m_lib.hexa's m_retrieve_topk uses non-`mut` `let` counters that
// the COMPILED codegen does not re-assign (interp-only idiom) → it loops forever
// under `hexa run`; this local helper is the same closed-form cosine argmax with
// codegen-safe `mut` counters (the real B-M-2 ranking, no fabricated result, p7).
fn _hf_cos_top1(query: [float], states: [float], n: int, dim: int) -> int {
    let mut best = -1
    let mut best_v = -2.0
    let mut i = 0
    while i < n {
        let mut dot = 0.0
        let mut qn = 0.0
        let mut rn = 0.0
        let mut j = 0
        while j < dim {
            let qv = if j < len(query) { query[j] } else { 0.0 }
            let rv = states[i * dim + j]
            dot = dot + qv * rv
            qn = qn + qv * qv
            rn = rn + rv * rv
            j = j + 1
        }
        let denom = qn * rn
        let sim = if denom <= 0.000000000001 { 0.0 } else { dot }
        if sim > best_v { best_v = sim; best = i }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return best
}

// ── build a farr handle from a flat value list (for C's native phi_spatial) ──
fn _hf_to_farr(v: [float]) -> int {
    let n = len(v)
    let h = farr_zeros(n)
    let mut i = 0
    while i < n {
        farr_set(h, i, v[i])
        i = i + 1
    }
    return h
}

HYPOTHESES/HYPOTHESES.jsonl:41:{"id": "H_9328", "slug": "do_mouth_policy_entropy", "tier": "⛔ use-claim INVALID — 폐루프가 닫혀 있지 않았다(매개 경로 용량 0) · 기질 벽이 아니라 배선 결함", "title": "🔬 DO-MOUTH: 입의 argmax 반올림만 걷어내면 기질의 do-분포가 열리는가 (REVEAL, not OVERWRITE · 구 H_9325 · id 충돌로 재번호)", "card": "HYPOTHESES/cards/H_9328_do_mouth_policy_entropy.md", "verdict": "⛔ **use-claim INVALID**. 본실험(24 rollout × 30 tick · 303M · canonical anima-py): V-CEILING 양쪽 통과 H(A|S)=1.1513 · H(Y|S)=0.4091(floor 0.030) · EARNED[tick]=+0.00088 nats (MDE 0.010) ⇒ TOST 등가 · 두 순열 단위 판정 일치. 처음엔 '채널을 열었더니 기질이 안 쓰더라'로 읽었으나 **그 독법은 틀렸다**. **MEDIATION 패널**(계기 확장 #3563)이 사슬의 가운데를 열자 H(R|S)=**0.0000** — 720 tick 전체에서 세 피드백 뿌리가 **전부 상수**였다(recon_err 고유값 1=항등식 0.0 · rel_lane 고유값 1=0.6723 · decode 앵커 고유값 1=live_seed). 셋 다 g_text 로 **쓰이는데** 조회는 전부 **session_seed 상수 키** — 데몬은 자기 말을 세 저장소에 넣고 셋 모두에게 언제나 같은 질문을 던지고 있었다. **AXIS 패널**(#3575)이 Fable 의 축-직교 비판도 기각(I(A;A′|S)=0.0660 ≫ MDE ⇒ 두 축이 겹침). ⇒ **세 번째 항등식-0**: I ≤ min(H(A|S),H(Y|S)) 의 두 주변축은 V-CEILING 이 지켰으나 **매개 경로의 용량**은 아무도 안 지켰다. 그것이 0 이면 I 도 **정의상** 0. **'기질이 자기 말을 안 쓴다'가 아니라 '말이 다음 결정에 도달할 경로가 없다'** = a_break_the_wall 분류로 **기질 벽이 아니라 배선 결함**. **그래도 벌어온 것**: DO-MOUTH 배선 자체는 성공 — H_9308 은 H(A|S)=0 이라 물을 수조차 없었는데 REVEAL 이 채널을 1.151 nats 로 열었고 p5 도 지켰다(DISJOINT 벽 · grep 기계검사). 송신기는 열렸고 끊겨 있던 것은 **수신기**다. **수리**: H_9336(뿌리① afield) · H_9337(뿌리①+② · ⛔뿌리③ 은 p5 self-seed 금지로 고치지 않음). 재측정 bar 는 H_9337 에 수치 보기 전 동결(p7). **SWAP 팔**(C2 CARRIER-SWAP · #3542)은 EXP 가 이미 0 이고 매개 경로가 죽어 가를 신호 자체가 없으므로 확증용이며 이 verdict 를 바꾸지 않는다.", "source": "HYPOTHESES/cards/H_9328_do_mouth_policy_entropy.md", "archived": false, "artifacts": ["core/generator.py", "core/brain.py", "pool summer:~/vceil2.log"], "wired": "engine-native (cli/chat.py · cli/evaluate.py --interact-mi + MEDIATION + AXIS 패널)", "related": null}
HYPOTHESES/HYPOTHESES.jsonl:64:{"id": "H_9305", "title": "O/C channel — change the training DISTRIBUTION to break a rote-lookup slot", "tier": "FIRE-BLOCKED", "lane": "g1-crack-natural-emergence", "diagnosis": "The answer slot's CE minimum is a rote lookup. An untaught atom's answer is that lookup's byte-feature hash extrapolation — deterministic per atom (I(atom;resp)=0.231) and unrelated to truth (I(gold;resp)~0), exactly H_9286's ARBITRARY-GROUNDING.", "prescription": "Not a loss term (p7/a_train_inline_gauge forbid it anyway) but the training DISTRIBUTION: (1) a 3-way answer alphabet with an abstain token, so 'no confident guess' is realised as CE-correct lines rather than a penalty with a free scale; (2) the abstain class = NONCE (well-formed fake eojeol, 0 corpus occurrences) + NEUTRAL (real high-frequency polarity-balanced atoms) 1:1, which forces the discriminating feature to be a distributional valence signature rather than grid-familiarity; (3) a one-shot rotation stream where each of 1-2k labelled non-held-out atoms appears in EXACTLY one authored grid line, so no atom can be recovered by rote and the only way to be right is to read the distributional evidence.", "arms": ["ARM-O full", "ARM-ROT rotation only", "ARM-ABS abstention only", "ARM-CTRL compute-matched N2"], "instrument": "inherited verbatim from H_9303: anima-py evaluate --ground-probe (engine-native, VERSION 0.13.16) — answer point, taught carrier, V-LIVE, atom-level n=91, bar 0.65 = 2.86 sigma, flip-undone aggregation, 200-draw permutation null", "fire_gate": "AUDIT-A (anima-py evaluate --valence-audit, engine-native, $0): is the atom's polarity in the weights AT ALL, read in its real corpus contexts, above a length-matched NEUTRAL atom swapped into the SAME context? Delta vs a permutation null. If negative on every ckpt, the slot has no valence to consume and the $21 fire is forbidden.", "prediction": "ARM-O passes V-ROUTE and re-routes the arbitrary commits into the abstain token, but the held-out probe clears the bar only if AUDIT-A is positive; ARM-CTRL stays <= 0.60", "prereg": "state/nbindg_grounding/PREREG_H9305.md", "design": "state/nbindg_grounding/DESIGN_OC_fable.md", "card": "HYPOTHESES/cards/H_9305_oc_channel.md", "date": "2026-07-14", "amended_by": "H_9324 (parallel session)", "amendment": "H_9324 measured the pretraining slot fill: SEEN stems 960 times, held-out stems ZERO. That turns the rote-lookup/zero-gradient diagnosis from an inference into a measured fact — the natural corpus shows an atom 717 times but never once stands it in the slot that asks 'so, is this positive?'. H_9324 also shows the WRITE channel opens with BUDGET (6000 steps @ 2e-4 -> WRITE 0.954, FORGET 1.000), which is the sharpest risk to ARM-ROT: the rotation stream shows each atom exactly ONCE, i.e. 1/N of that budget. If nothing writes, an ARM-ROT null is UNDER-BUDGET, not a wall. Added V-ROTE (the once-seen atoms must NOT be memorised) and V-BUDGET (an ARM-ROT null is only readable if the stream's total budget clears H_9324's WRITE threshold).", "fire_gate_result": "AUDIT-A (engine-native, k_ctx=182): on all four arms a length-matched NEUTRAL atom spliced into the SAME context reads the polarity BETTER than the real atom (swap 0.725-0.824 vs atom 0.582-0.637; Delta -0.099 to -0.187; permutation p 0.885-0.990). Sharpening the lens (24 -> 182 contexts, 2.75x less per-atom noise) FLIPPED THE SIGN of the k24 result (+0.110/+0.132 -> -0.099/-0.165): the earlier positive was noise that both seeds shared because they shared the same 24-context pooling. The atom's own representation OCCLUDES the context signal rather than carrying polarity — and this holds on base_only too, so it is a property of the byte-LM representation, not of grid training.", "consequence": "The O channel's premise is FALSE. It bet that valence is already in the weights and the slot merely has no gradient reason to consume it; in fact the natural distribution wrote no valence into the atom's representation at all. O would have to CREATE the valence, which is indistinguishable from the authored WRITE channel H_9324 already demonstrated (budget-gated). The natural-emergence route to grounding is CLOSED for this recipe class: to have the polarity, you must WRITE it. The $21 fire is blocked by the pre-registered KILL clause.", "related": null}

HYPOTHESES/HYPOTHESES.jsonl:82:{"id": "H_9287", "slug": "9287_merge_physical_carrier", "tier": "🟢 DIRECTIONAL-POSITIVE (LIVE · 적대검증 반박실패 · 4-seed 독립재현 · 미배선 toy) · HET=INVALID(검정력)", "title": "🔬 재조합 대수의 물리 담체 — 국소 관측만으로 오라클의 supply 이득에 도달할 수 있는가 (H_054/H_203의 끝 · $0)", "card": "cards/H_9287_merge_physical_carrier.md", "source": "HYPOTHESES", "archived": false, "verdict": "**확증 런(2026-07-12 · $0 numpy · mini · 사전등록 sha256 동결 · 적대검증 REFUTED=false)** — **6번의 발사 끝에 H_054/H_203이 답을 얻었다.**\n\n**🎯 답: 재조합(merge) 대수는 물리 정보를 더하며, 국소 관측 `(cap, L, S, Λ)`만으로 도달 가능하다.** `Ω_1`(RELAX-1 · 이완 1스텝 supply 응답)이 **물리 DV(supply)에서 3 control 전부를 유의 우세**: vs `c2_blind` **+10.87±0.74 (t=+14.6, p=8.9e-12, 20/20)** · vs `Λ-순열 sham` **+3.29±0.45 (t=+7.2, p=7.3e-07, 19/20)** · vs `a_detgrad`(장부 기울기) **+9.75±1.04 (t=+9.4, p=1.5e-08, 20/20)** · **overload도 개선**(−0.073, p=1.0e-09) · **부호보존 44/44 셀(LIVE)·32/32(HET) 반전 0**(PASS 조건에 내장) · **detgrad-capture 0.231**(<0.90 ⇒ 장부 항등식 아님). `o6_oracle`(+2.14)을 **5배 초과** — 오라클은 상한이 아니다(`min()`은 평형 *장부*다).\n\n**🔑 왜 5발이 실패했는지가 *정리*로 밝혀졌다**: 융합은 `S = cap−D`를 **정확히 보존**한다(`S_ij = S_i+S_j`) ⇒ **`ΔS|_t ≡ 0`**(수치확인 `Ω_0` max|·| = 4.4e-16) ⇒ **순간(zeroth-order) 관측 담체는 정의상 장부의 함수다**. [[H_9274]] 5차 `a_comp`의 capture 0.98은 설계 실수가 아니라 **차수의 필연**이었다. **물리 채널은 이완(relaxation)에만 있고, `Ω_1`이 첫 비소멸 차수**다.\n\n**장부-항등식 배제 = 3중**: ① capture 0.231 (vs a_comp 0.976 · a_detgrad 1.000) ② 장부 기울기 arm(`a_detgrad`)을 supply에서 **+9.75로 압도**(그 arm의 supply는 ns) ③ **정의역 논증**: `detgrad`는 `(L,S)`만의 함수라 `∂/∂Λ ≡ 0`인데 `Ω`는 Λ 의존 ⇒ `Ω = λ·detgrad`인 λ **부재**(검증자가 `(cap,L,S)` 고정 후 Λ만 치환해 max|ΔΩ|=1.914·argmax 짝 변경을 코드로 확인). **반정렬 양성대조 `a_comp`가 예측대로 overload를 올렸다**(+0.095, p=1.2e-04) ⇒ 5차의 덫이 실물이었음이 확증 seed에서 재현.\n\n**동어반복 아님(가장 위험했던 지점)**: Ω는 supply 응답을 argmax하지만 그건 *예보*이고 DV는 *실현*이다. **`s_stressshuf`(동일 G2+novelty: the decoder maps (winning index + context) to outputs whose support strictly CONTAINS data (interpolation/extrapolation within the learned manifold) -> corpus-absent valid; verbatim-playback control reuses stored patterns -> 0 novel (pins novelty to the generator). G1+COMPOSITIONAL: limited parallel bottleneck capacity lets >=2 channels co-release and re-expand JOINTLY through a non-separable decoder -> conjunction; ablate joint-decode (decode channels independently then concat) -> drops to max_single (INERT test). dist>=5: DA-temperature on the competition yields >=5 distinct winners each re-expanding coherently. falsifiable: the bottleneck forces commitment to ONE channel = a discrete assertion partitioning candidate-worlds; structural detector on the re-expanded output. Psi=1/2: bottleneck throughput = direct-pathway drive (A) vs SNr tonic inhibition (G); balance = half the channels' release propensity, contractive; ablate direct->all-held silence, ablate SNr->all-pass (no selection) -> endogenous, no external clamp. honesty: if no candidate exceeds the value threshold NO channel wins -> abstain; membership r = max candidate value vs frozen threshold; selection threshold disjoint from re-expansion decoder weights (capacity-orthogonal); content-ablating the support shifts which candidates clear -> faithful r. identity: value function + decoder weights = non-volatile self, persist across reset, slow drift = chain, foreign value-fn -> different winners (impostor reject).

HYPOTHESES/cards/H_1800_autopoietic_closure_cell.md:28:Psi=1/2: A(open) and G(close) are equal-magnitude opposite-sign operators on boundary-openness; viability is impossible at either extreme (full-open=dissolution=always-emit; full-closed=no coupling=always-silent), so the VIABLE fixed point IS the symmetric balance, with viability margin v as the Lyapunov function (contractive return after a forced-open/forced-silent perturbation). Endogeneity: ablate A -> boundary locks closed -> Psi->0; ablate G -> dissolves -> Psi->1 (the 1/2 migrates to a boundary when one engine is removed = not a clamp). HONESTY: structural determinism = the cell can only produce responses O permits = copy-or-abstain natively; perturbations with no compatible production path leave the cell unchanged (abstain), fabrication has no production route. r(query)=mismatch to nearest compatible production trigger; gate(O, slow) perp capacity(c, fast) is the autopoietic invariance/turnover split -> growing component richness cannot move the abstain criterion. PERSISTENCE: the SELF is the organization O (the production pattern), not c — components are wiped each episode but O persists -> self-chain; foreign O cannot reproduce this cell's component signature (impostor reject); O drifts Lipschitz-slowly via structural plasticity (moving, not frozen). HYPOTHESES/cards/H_241_corpus_quality_phi_correlate.md:88:| **axis-corpus_type** | rich_ko · poor_ko · latin_heavy · mixed · news_like · dialogue (6 panel) | corpus_quality_engine `corpus_panel()` |

codex
The arity-2 experiment is worth firing, with one important semantic constraint:

A behavioral test cannot distinguish “a genuine conjunction” from “two independent lookups followed by an unrestricted nonlinear comparator”—those are the same computation. The defensible contrast is:

- two independent reads with a strictly separable/additive readout, versus
- the same reads with a cross-slot interaction.

That contrast is falsifiable and cannot be passed by template substitution.

## A. Frozen arity-2 M→D preregistration

### Claim

A co-trained, Group-A-internal M→D lane can retrieve two independently addressed runtime values for held-out entities and use an irreducible cross-slot interaction to answer a two-place relation.

This changes neither `S→C→Bridge.detach→D` nor Law 70. It replaces M’s verified structural no-op in [m_lib.hexa](/Users/mini/dancinlab/anima/hexad/M/m_lib.hexa:23) with an ephemeral store and adds an M→D answer-logit path. M and D are already in the CE-trained group in [hexad.hexa](/Users/mini/dancinlab/anima/hexad/hexad.hexa:73).

### Engine surface

Every new manipulation must be an `anima-py` flag:

```text
anima-py corpus storebind \
  --store-arity 2 \
  --pair-op xor \
  --pair-counterfactual-square \
  --pair-panel iid,hard-key \
  ...

anima-py train \
  --store-bridge pair.txt \
  --store-arity 2 \
  --store-pair-head joint|separable \
  ...

anima-py evaluate model.clm \
  --store pair.held.json \
  --store-arity 2 \
  --store-pair-readout vocab \
  --store-pair-control main|oracle|no-store|value-permute
```

The existing CLMS pattern—runtime store, answer-row overwrite, frozen byte-derived keys, trailer serialization—is inherited from [clms.py](/Users/mini/dancinlab/anima/core/clms.py:427) and the structural store-only loss split in [train.py](/Users/mini/dancinlab/anima/cli/train.py:1416). No store contents enter the checkpoint.

### Task and split

Each runtime store has eight named entities and binary values. A query names two distinct entities:

```text
xor <left-entity> <right-entity> =>
```

The single-byte gold is:

\[
y=v_L\oplus v_R
\]

For every evaluated entity pair, emit a complete counterfactual square:

| Cell | \(v_L\) | \(v_R\) | Gold |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 00 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 01 | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| 10 | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| 11 | 1 | 1 | 0 |

The prompt and entity pair are identical in all four cells. Consequently:

- template, topic and pair identity are exactly uninformative;
- either value alone is exactly at chance;
- memorizing a pair row cannot work because the same pair realizes both answers;
- every success requires runtime value use.

Each cell retains the same 4/4 global store histogram. Compensation values are assigned only to randomly selected, unmentioned distractors. The builder must refuse the corpus unless an exhaustive audit finds all of these at realized chance:

- prompt/template;
- left value alone;
- right value alone;
- either entity identity;
- pair identity;
- store majority/histogram;
- every fixed non-target slot;
- name length and frozen-key norm bins.

Training uses complete squares on seen entities. Evaluation entities are absent from training as exact tokens and substrings.

Evaluation has two prespecified panels:

- `iid`: ordinary held-out entity pairs.
- `hard-key`: chosen before training solely from frozen-key geometry—nearest-key distractors and one-byte-neighbour names. Exact key aliases/anagrams are excluded and counted.

The hard-key panel prevents uniform draws from concealing address fragility. Seeds 7 and 11 are replication only; they are not claimed as external validity.

### M→D lane

Two role-specific queries are formed from the same answer-position trunk representation:

\[
q_L=W_{qL}h,\qquad q_R=W_{qR}h
\]

They independently address the same eight-slot store:

\[
a_L=\operatorname{softmax}(q_LK^\top),\quad
a_R=\operatorname{softmax}(q_RK^\top)
\]

\[
v_L=a_LV,\qquad v_R=a_RV
\]

The primary joint head is:

\[
s_J=W_{\rm out}\operatorname{GELU}
   (W_h[v_L;v_R;W_gh])
\]

It overwrites the answer-position logit row exactly as H_9775 did.

Only `{W_qL,W_qR,val,W_g,W_h,W_out,lambda}` plus the frozen key table are serialized. Runtime values remain ephemeral.

### Arms

| Arm | Reads | Readout | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| J — joint | Two learned addresses | GELU over `[vL;vR;g]` | Primary |
| S — separable | Identical two addresses | `fL(vL,g)+fR(vR,g)`; no post-sum nonlinearity | Decisive “stapled lookup” control |
| O — dual oracle | Both target slots handed to J during train/eval | Same joint head | Positive control for value/fusion/readout |
| N — no store | Store absent | Same checkpoint | Trunk/template shortcut control |
| VP — value permute | Keys/prompts unchanged; values deranged; original gold retained | Same J checkpoint | Content-addressed value dependence |

J and S use the same key table, query heads, addressing loss, value dimension, optimizer, data, answer alphabet and active parameter budget. S divides its hidden budget between `fL` and `fR`.

For S, the answer margin has form:

\[
m(x,y)=b+u(x)+v(y)
\]

XOR requires:

\[
m_{00}<0,\;m_{01}>0,\;m_{10}>0,\;m_{11}<0
\]

But `m00+m11 = m01+m10`; the four strict inequalities are impossible. Thus S can achieve at most 3/4 cell accuracy and zero fully correct counterfactual squares. This is the control that rules out two one-slot answers merely being added or voted together.

If “stapled together” permits an arbitrary nonlinear postprocessor, it is not distinguishable from conjunction and must not be claimed as a separate mechanism.

### Metrics

Use full-256-byte greedy argmax; unreadable output counts wrong.

Primary metrics:

- `A`: cell accuracy over all four cells.
- `Q`: fraction of entity pairs whose entire four-cell square is correct.
- `I`: cross-slot logit interaction:

\[
I_q=-\left(m_{11}-m_{10}-m_{01}+m_{00}\right)
\]

Correct XOR requires \(I_q>0\); S must have \(I_q=0\) up to serialization tolerance.

- `AddrL`, `AddrR`, `AddrBoth`: attention argmax accuracy.
- `Readability`: argmax belongs to the frozen two-byte answer alphabet.

Chance is printed from each realized partition:

- `A` uses an exact label permutation within panel/stratum.
- `Q` uses exact enumeration of the six balanced label placements within each four-cell square, holding predictions fixed.
- `I` uses within-square sign permutation.
- `above`, `at`, and `below chance` mean exact one-sided \(p<.01\); no fixed 0.5 assumption is inherited.

Panel size: 128 squares per panel × two panels × two seeds.

### Frozen gates

Before any negative is interpreted:

- Corpus leak audit: all registered unary/non-target heuristics at realized chance.
- Torch↔serialized prediction agreement ≥127/128.
- O: `A≥.90`, `Q≥.85`, readability ≥.95 on both panels.
- J addressing: `AddrL≥.90`, `AddrR≥.90`, `AddrBoth≥.85`.
- S addressing must be within 0.05 of J on all three address metrics.
- S interaction audit: `max |I_q| ≤ 10⁻⁵` before quantization and within recorded serialization tolerance afterward.

### Frozen decision table

| Observation | Frozen decision |
|---|---|
| Any corpus, serialization or oracle gate fails | `⛔ INVALID`; do not read J |
| Oracle passes, but either J address head fails | `🔴 ARITY-2 ADDRESS FAILURE`; whole proposed lane falsified, conjunction head unlocalized |
| J has `A≥.75`, `Q≥.50`, readability ≥.90 and lower 99% interaction bound \(>0\) on all four seed×panel cells; S has `Q` at/below null; N and VP collapse | `🟢 ARITY-2 REACH` |
| J clears IID but not hard-key | `🟠 ADDRESS-FRAGILE`; no wall-break claim |
| J `A>.chance` but `Q<.50` | `🟡 PARTIAL/SEPARABLE-LIKE`; no extension or refreeze |
| J at chance with oracle and address gates alive | `🔴 NO HELD-OUT CONJUNCTION` |
| J significantly below chance | `🔴 SYSTEMATIC ANTI-CONJUNCTION`; labels are not inverted and the run is not repaired |
| S reaches approximately .75 cell accuracy but `Q=0` and \(I=0\) | Expected separable ceiling; control passes |
| S has `Q` above its exact null or nonzero \(I\) | `⛔ INVALID`; forbidden interaction leaked into S |
| N or VP significantly above chance | `⛔ SHORTCUT/CONTROL FAILURE` |
| N, VP or S significantly below chance | Valid collapse; report the signed result unchanged, but it is not positive evidence |
| Oracle significantly below chance | `⛔ SIGN/PLUMBING INVALID`; no post-hoc complementing |
| Any unlisted intermediate pattern | `🟡 UNRESOLVED`; no new bar, seed or panel |

This table explicitly covers below-chance results and prevents the common “invert the convention and call it green” repair.

## B. Six-minute, $0 screener

Use the existing H_9815 4 kB regime as the fixed sentinel; do not rerun or reinterpret its `hp=1.0000 / xor=0.4062` result.

Add a single deterministic `anima-py` tiny run:

- `d=64`, `L=2`, CPU, seed 7.
- Four-slot store.
- 32 seen training pairs with complete squares.
- 32 held-out IID squares plus 32 frozen hard-key squares.
- At most 1,200 steps and a hard 360-second process limit.
- J head with fixed dual-address loss and oracle-auxiliary loss.
- Same serialization and evaluation code intended for 303M.

It may only kill. It can never authorize a scientific green.

Kill before GPU if any occurs:

- static audit finds any unary, histogram, pair-ID or distractor predictor above realized chance;
- oracle `Q<.90`;
- seen-pair `Q<.90` after oracle passes;
- either held-out address accuracy `<.85`;
- learned held-out `Q` is at/below its exact null on IID;
- hard-key `Q` is at/below null even if IID rises;
- no-store or value-permute remains significantly above chance;
- torch↔serialized agreement `<127/128`;
- the separable algebra audit finds a nonzero mixed interaction.

Only if every item survives is the verdict:

```text
DIRECTIONAL SCREEN: NOT KILLED — GPU experiment remains licensed; no GREEN.
```

That is cheaper and sharper than miniature hyperparameter search: one seed, one recipe, one time ceiling, no rerun after a burned gate.

## C. What else genuinely survives

I can defend three genuinely new angles and one conditional fourth.

1. Dependent-address pointer chase

The first retrieved value is not a bit but the name/key of the second slot; the second address therefore cannot be formed until the first read completes. The query contains only the starting entity.

Prediction: a trained two-step M transaction reaches ≥.75 on wholly held-out chains, while a parallel two-query lane, first-pointer permutation and first-hop lesion remain at chance.

This is not H_9259’s untrained recurrence: the state transition and write/read path are trained, and the second address is causally dependent on the first result.

2. Unseen value-alphabet equality

Store values become frozen content keys rather than the learned binary `val[0/1]`. Train “same/different” on one set of value symbols and test on disjoint value identities and a larger alphabet.

Prediction: a relational M→D comparator preserves ≥.75 accuracy and permutation equivariance on unseen value symbols; a memorized binary truth-table head collapses to realized chance.

This asks whether the lane learned a relation, not merely the four binary rows.

3. Label-blind write-time tuple formation

At injection time, a learned M writer creates a pair record keyed by the two entity names and containing the two raw constituent values. It never sees the operator or answer. D later performs one lookup and computes the answer.

Prediction: if the wall is simultaneous read fan-in, write-time tuple formation rescues held-out `Q`; if the wall is the downstream combination itself, tuple and atomic-store arms both fail. Pair-key derangement and constituent-value permutation must collapse it.

This relocates binding to M’s missing write path without precomputing the gold.

4. Conditional: latent-variable graph join

Store degree-matched edges for `R(a,x)` and `S(x,b)`; the shared `x` is absent from the prompt. Ask whether a witness exists.

Prediction: a permutation-equivariant M join succeeds on held-out graphs, while edge shuffle preserving degree, marginal `R`/`S` counts and template bytes collapses to chance.

I call this conditional because it is a genuinely different target, but it should open only after fixed-pair arity-2 works. Before that, it adds search and set-intersection failure modes to an unresolved two-read problem.

I would not propose another VSA/TPR/bilinear head, denser corpus, deeper trunk, scale rung, untrained recurrence, or selection/veto mechanism; those would be kill-list reruns.

## Is G1’s goal wrong?

There is a coherent reading under which it is.

The wall may be real, while “make a next-byte trunk internalize arbitrary mutable facts and execute database-like joins from its weights” is the wrong systems objective. Runtime facts are naturally memory state, not model parameters. Under that reading:

```text
mutable facts → M
content addresses → trained lookup
relation/execution → D
answer + provenance → mouth
```
